text: Why is returning -1 an acceptable sentinel for indexOf but not for a temperature?
choices: Because -1 is a special value in Java
Because indexOf is in the standard library
An index cannot be negative, so the value cannot be mistaken for a real answer
explanation: A sentinel is dangerous exactly when it could pass as a valid result. -1 is impossible as an index and entirely plausible as a temperature, and a sentinel used as if it were an answer produces a wrong result with no error — the worst outcome available.
